verdict: Paid ads are not live yet; organic activity is your only active source.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Google Business Profile was the only channel generating activity — 82 total actions including 15 calls, 28 direction requests, and 39 website clicks. Paid search and paid social have not launched, meaning zero ad spend and zero paid leads this period. Getting paid channels live is the immediate priority, and that work is actively being resolved now. Once ads are running, lead volume will no longer depend entirely on organic visibility.
